payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details about the inference model used to estimate socioeconomic status (SES) from online behavioral data.

claims.text: The inference model for estimating socioeconomic status relies on three datasets: socioeconomic census data, crawled professional profiles, and expert annotated Google Street View images.
The model uses online semantics from Twitter users to infer SES, indicating a combination of individual characteristics and environmental variables.
The approach allows for the estimation of SES for a large sample of Twitter users, contributing to insights on social stratification and inequalities.
